steps.name: fetch-and-verify-and-publish
argv:
# ONE step, on purpose: it fetches, it ASSERTS THE BYTES, and it writes
# its manifest straight into courier-box\farm-out. That last part is not
# decoration -- ep2-cnet-probe-0817 rendered perfectly on 2026-08-17 and
# was invisible for two days because nothing carried its output to the
# only directory the courier pushes from, and box_enqueue.courier_problems
# now refuses a spec that repeats it.
import hashlib, os, sys
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
REPO = "xinsir/controlnet-openpose-sdxl-1.0"
# EXACTLY these two. Without the patterns this pull is ~5,014 MB because
# the repo also ships a second 2.5 GB `_twins` weight file plus ~10 MB of
# .webp showcase art, and none of it is load-bearing for diffusers.
WANT = {"config.json": 1235,
        "diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors": 2502139104}
d = snapshot_download(REPO, allow_patterns=sorted(WANT))
print("snapshot:", d, flush=True)
bad, lines = [], []
for name, size in sorted(WANT.items()):
    p = os.path.join(d, name)
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        bad.append("MISSING " + name); continue
    n = os.path.getsize(p)
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(p, "rb") as fh:
        for c in iter(lambda: fh.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(c)
    lines.append("%s  %d  %s" % (h.hexdigest(), n, name))
    print("  %-40s %13d bytes (want %13d)" % (name, n, size), flush=True)
    if n != size:
        bad.append("SIZE %s: %d != %d" % (name, n, size))
# A half-finished download must fail HERE. huggingface_hub leaves
# .incomplete blobs behind on an interrupted transfer and a later offline
# load of a truncated safetensors is a confusing failure a long way from
# its cause -- macbook1/macbook3 rendered SDXL as pure noise for days on a
# UNet that was the exact right length.
hub = os.environ.get("HF_HOME", "") + r"\hub"
inc = []
for root, _, files in os.walk(hub):
    if "openpose" in root.lower():
        inc += [os.path.join(root, f) for f in files
                if f.endswith(".incomplete")]
if inc:
    bad.append("%d .incomplete file(s) left behind" % len(inc))
dst = r"C:\banyan-farm\courier-box\farm-out\ep2-b08-posenet-fetch-0819"
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
with open(os.path.join(dst, "ep2-b08-posenet-fetch-0819.sha256"), "w",
          newline="\n", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    fh.write("# %s, allow_patterns=%s, variant NOT passed\n"
             % (REPO, sorted(WANT)))
    fh.write("# snapshot: %s\n" % d)
    fh.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
    fh.write("# incomplete_files: %d\n" % len(inc))
if bad:
    print("!! " + "; ".join(bad), file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(1)
print("rc=0", flush=True)
